illustrates.quote: Insert a transcriber’s note when the superscript numbers appear before the entry words in print.

blocks.text:
¹live /lĭv/ v. intr. To be alive; exist
²live /līv/ adj. Having life; alive: live animals
blocks.features: Superscript numbers before the entry word. F-199: nothing repositions a superscript number that precedes the entry word in print to follow it in braille — recorded as not representable rather than hand-moved to imitate the rule's own required OUTPUT rather than its INPUT.

print.notes: Dictionary entries with superscript numbers preceding the entry word.
